global_style.style_preamble: Editorial investigative product-film aesthetic. Dark graphite background (#2D2D2D). Clean modern sans-serif typography. Restrained, serious, trustworthy. No neon, no particle effects, no glowing AI brains, no stock-photo energy. Flat matte surfaces, soft directional lighting, subtle depth-of-field. Color accents only where specified. 16:9 aspect ratio, 1920x1080.

assets.subject: Graph emergence from clutter
assets.prompt_body: Wide composition on dark graphite background showing a left-to-right transformation. Left side: faint echoes of information clutter, translucent document panels, PDF fragments, chat excerpts, and entity lists in very muted off-white and cool gray, fading and receding as they drift leftward. The chaos is dissolving. Right side: a clean graph structure emerging, off-white circular nodes connected by muted teal lines forming a sparse, readable node-link silhouette. The teal lines are the brightest element in the composition, pulling the scattered fragments into connected order. A subtle directional gradient flows left-to-right, reinforcing the sense of resolution: noise becoming structure. The left side feels like it is being left behind; the right side feels like it is arriving. No amber accents. The mood is relief and clarity, not spectacle. The graph emerges through connection, not through magic. Organic, earned, purposeful.
assets.negative_prompt: Neon colors, glowing transformation effects, magic-wand aesthetics, instant before/after with dramatic lighting, AI brain imagery, particle effects, celebratory energy, any readable real text, 3D elements.
notes: Visual payoff to IMG-S01-A. The clutter on the left should feel like faded remnants of the same visual language from slide 1.

assets.subject: Multi-domain graph pattern montage
assets.prompt_body: Centered grid or loose-cluster layout on dark graphite background. Six small graph-pattern vignettes arranged in a 2x3 or 3x2 grid, each inside a thin slate blue border frame. Each vignette shows a different small node-link sketch representing a domain where graph structure matters: biology as a molecular-network shape with branching nodes, governance as a hierarchical tree with institutional tiers, investigations as a person-entity web linking people and organizations, ownership as a vertical corporate chain with parent-child relationships, kinship as a family-tree fragment with generational layers, and influence as a communication network with radiating connections from central nodes. All vignettes use muted teal outlines for nodes and edges. Below each vignette, a small off-white sans-serif domain label. Use subtle variety in node shapes across domains, such as circles, squares, and diamonds, without breaking the palette. Generous spacing between vignettes. The overall message is breadth of application: graphs are everywhere, not just in tech demos.
assets.negative_prompt: Detailed scientific diagrams, dense academic graph visualizations, 3D renders, glowing nodes, literal photographs of biology, governance, or investigations, stock imagery, overly technical notation, any single domain dominating the composition, bright colors beyond teal accents.
notes: Each vignette should be instantly readable at a glance. Think icon-scale sketches, not full diagrams.

assets.subject: Four governance pillars card
assets.prompt_body: Centered composition on dark graphite background. Four rectangular governance-pillar cards arranged in a horizontal row, evenly spaced. Each card is a rounded rectangle with a slate blue background and a warm amber accent line on the top edge. Inside each card: a small abstract glyph or icon at the top, geometric not literal, such as a grid for schema, an eye for evidence, a hand for curation, and a trail for auditability. Below each glyph, the pillar name in off-white sans-serif: Schema, Evidence, Curation, Auditability. Below each name, a very small one-line descriptor in smaller off-white text: Rules of the world, Source-linked, Human-reviewed, Every change traced. Behind and below the four cards, a faint governed graph structure is barely visible, muted teal nodes and edges at very low opacity, suggesting the ordered graph these pillars produce. The cards are the hero elements; the background graph is texture only. The overall feel is structured, authoritative, and deliberate. Not flashy. Grounded.
assets.negative_prompt: Literal icons, including shields, locks, checkmarks, or badge imagery, bright amber, 3D cards, drop shadows, decorative flourishes, gradient backgrounds, celebratory energy, any suggestion these are features to sell rather than principles to stand on.
notes: This directly answers the messy problem framing from IMG-S07-A and introduces amber as the governance signal.

assets.section: S13 - Neo4all takeaway / Part II bridge
assets.subject: Canvas teaser divider
assets.prompt_body: Asymmetric composition on dark graphite background. Upper-left corner: a small, settled governed graph, a compact cluster of off-white nodes connected by muted teal lines, complete and resolved, occupying roughly 15 to 20 percent of the frame. This is the output of Neo4all, done and stable. The rest of the frame is a large, open, dark canvas space. Within this space, a very faint slate blue grid or spatial field is barely visible, just enough to suggest a workspace waiting to be used. The grid lines are subtle, almost imperceptible, hinting at the spatial investigation environment that G-Lap will provide. The center of the open space is reserved for a question-prompt text overlay and must remain clear. The overall feeling is cinematic transition: stepping from a completed room into an open workspace. The graph is done; now the investigation begins. Spacious, anticipatory, grounded. Optional very faint watermark only at extremely low opacity.
assets.negative_prompt: Full UI mockups, bright grid lines, detailed canvas tools, any suggestion the workspace is already populated, celebratory energy, split-screen before and after, neon or glowing elements, text baked into the image.
notes: This bridges Part I and Part II. The small graph should echo IMG-S13-A but shrink into context while the canvas space becomes the subject.
